field.$description: v0.6 — Layout tokens for the Field composition (label + control + helper + error). The field shell itself uses input.* tokens; this file owns vertical rhythm + label/helper typography roles.

labelToControl.$description: Label below stacked over the control.

controlToHelp.$description: Control above the hint or error message.

groupToGroup.$description: Vertical rhythm between fields in a form. Modern peer-system convergence: 16-20 px.

fieldsetToFieldset.$description: Vertical rhythm between fieldsets / form sections.

label.$description: Field label. Uppercase mono is reserved for system metadata; field labels stay sentence-case sans-medium.

optional.$description: The `(optional)` suffix on a label. NN/g preference over the asterisk pattern.

helper.$description: Hint or description shown beneath the control.

error.$description: Error message. role=alert; aria-describedby includes its id.
